inputs.text: It’s being framed as generosity, but the aid and other promises look more like an effort to buy loyalty. Bigger monthly aid for women, Rs 8,000 household coupons, free pumpsets for farmers and promises to fishermen are the visible bait, while talk of FDI, jobs and AI gives it a modern gloss. The key question is who will profit from investment and technology while the public is encouraged to focus on handouts. These promises don’t prove public-minded intentions; they look designed to secure support and keep deeper interests out of sight.
